WITH fact_fix AS (
  SELECT f.psgc_code AS psgc_code,
         f.year AS year,
         f.indicator_code,
         f.raw_score
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_cmci_indicator f
),
latest AS (
  SELECT psgc_code, MAX(year) AS max_year
  FROM fact_fix
  GROUP BY psgc_code
),
lgus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.psgc_code, la.max_year
  FROM latest la
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
    WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
  ) l
    ON la.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
),
grid AS (
  SELECT g.psgc_code, g.max_year, d.indicator_code
  FROM lgus g
  CROSS JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator d
),
scored AS (
  SELECT g.psgc_code, g.max_year, g.indicator_code,
         f.raw_score
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN fact_fix f
    ON f.psgc_code = g.psgc_code
   AND f.year = g.max_year
   AND f.indicator_code = g.indicator_code
)
SELECT s.psgc_code,
       CONCAT_WS(' - ', p.area_name, l.area_name) AS province_city,
       l.area_name,
       l.province_code,
       rr.region_code,
       reg.area_name AS region_name,
       s.max_year AS year,
       d.pillar_name,
       d.indicator_code,
       d.indicator_name,
       s.raw_score,
       TRY_CAST(s.raw_score AS DOUBLE) AS raw_score_num,
       CASE WHEN s.raw_score IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS coverage_pct
FROM scored s
JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator d
  ON s.indicator_code = d.indicator_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name, province_code
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
) l
  ON s.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, region_code
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
) rr
  ON s.psgc_code = rr.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level = 'REG'
) reg
  ON rr.region_code = reg.psgc_code

LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu p ON l.province_code = p.psgc_code AND p.geographic_level = 'PROV'

SELECT d.psgc_code, d.area_name, d.geographic_level, d.region_code, d.province_code, d.population_year, d.population,
       r.area_name AS region_name, p.area_name AS province_name
FROM (
  SELECT psgc_code, area_name, geographic_level, region_code, province_code, population_year, population
  FROM (
    SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY psgc_code ORDER BY population_year DESC) rn
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_population
    WHERE population IS NOT NULL
  ) x WHERE rn = 1
) d
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu WHERE geographic_level = 'REG') r
  ON d.region_code = r.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu WHERE geographic_level = 'PROV') p
  ON d.province_code = p.psgc_code

SELECT f.psgc_code, l.area_name AS lgu_name, f.lgu_type, f.region,
       f.province, f.fiscal_year, f.match_status,
       l.region_code, r.area_name AS region_name,
       f.total_appropriation, f.total_expenditure, f.utilization_rate_total,
       CASE WHEN f.utilization_rate_total IS NULL THEN 'No reported utilization'
            WHEN f.utilization_rate_total < 0.5 THEN 'Below 50% utilization'
            WHEN f.utilization_rate_total < 0.65 THEN '50% to below 65% utilization'
            ELSE 'At least 65% utilization' END AS utilization_tier
FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_ldrrmf f
JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu l
  ON f.psgc_code = l.psgc_code AND f.source_period = l.source_period
 AND l.geographic_level IN ('CITY', 'MUN')
LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu r
  ON l.region_code = r.psgc_code AND l.source_period = r.source_period
 AND r.geographic_level = 'REG'
WHERE NOT f.has_dq_issues

WITH indicator_rows AS (
WITH fact_fix AS (
  SELECT f.psgc_code AS psgc_code,
         f.year AS year,
         f.indicator_code,
         f.raw_score
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_cmci_indicator f
),
latest AS (
  SELECT psgc_code, MAX(year) AS max_year
  FROM fact_fix
  GROUP BY psgc_code
),
lgus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.psgc_code, la.max_year
  FROM latest la
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
    WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
  ) l
    ON la.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
),
grid AS (
  SELECT g.psgc_code, g.max_year, d.indicator_code
  FROM lgus g
  CROSS JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator d
),
scored AS (
  SELECT g.psgc_code, g.max_year, g.indicator_code,
         f.raw_score
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN fact_fix f
    ON f.psgc_code = g.psgc_code
   AND f.year = g.max_year
   AND f.indicator_code = g.indicator_code
)
SELECT s.psgc_code,
       l.area_name,
       l.province_code,
       rr.region_code,
       reg.area_name AS region_name,
       s.max_year AS year,
       d.pillar_name,
       d.indicator_code,
       d.indicator_name,
       s.raw_score,
       TRY_CAST(s.raw_score AS DOUBLE) AS raw_score_num,
       CASE WHEN s.raw_score IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS coverage_pct
FROM scored s
JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator d
  ON s.indicator_code = d.indicator_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name, province_code
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
) l
  ON s.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, region_code
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
) rr
  ON s.psgc_code = rr.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level = 'REG'
) reg
  ON rr.region_code = reg.psgc_code
), funding AS (
  SELECT l.region_code, SUM(f.total_appropriation) AS appropriation,
         AVG(f.utilization_rate_total) AS avg_utilization
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_ldrrmf f
JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu l
  ON f.psgc_code = l.psgc_code AND f.source_period = l.source_period
 AND l.geographic_level IN ('CITY', 'MUN')
LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu r
  ON l.region_code = r.psgc_code AND l.source_period = r.source_period
 AND r.geographic_level = 'REG'
WHERE NOT f.has_dq_issues
  GROUP BY l.region_code
), pop AS (
  SELECT region_code, SUM(population) AS region_population
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_population
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('CITY', 'MUN')
  GROUP BY region_code
), coverage AS (
  SELECT region_code, AVG(coverage_pct) / 100.0 AS cmci_readiness
  FROM indicator_rows GROUP BY region_code
)
SELECT reg.psgc_code AS region_code, reg.area_name AS region_name,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS latitude, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS longitude,
       f.appropriation, f.avg_utilization, p.region_population,
       c.cmci_readiness, CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS quake_count,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS max_magnitude,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS risk_score,
       'Unavailable - geographic and risk methods pending' AS risk_tier
FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu reg
LEFT JOIN funding f ON reg.psgc_code = f.region_code
LEFT JOIN pop p ON reg.psgc_code = p.region_code
LEFT JOIN coverage c ON reg.psgc_code = c.region_code
WHERE reg.geographic_level = 'REG'

       `Location` AS location, event_time,
       CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS region_code,
       CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS region_name
FROM ahon_dev.silver.philvolcs_earthquake_observation_clean

config.source:
SELECT p.psgc_code AS province_code, initcap(p.area_name) AS province_name,
       SUM(f.total_appropriation) AS appropriation,
       AVG(f.utilization_rate_total) AS avg_utilization,
       CASE WHEN AVG(f.utilization_rate_total) IS NULL THEN 'No reported utilization'
            WHEN AVG(f.utilization_rate_total) < 0.5 THEN 'Below 50% utilization'
            WHEN AVG(f.utilization_rate_total) < 0.65 THEN '50% to below 65% utilization'
            ELSE 'At least 65% utilization' END AS risk_tier
FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_ldrrmf f
JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu l
  ON f.psgc_code = l.psgc_code AND f.source_period = l.source_period
 AND l.geographic_level IN ('CITY', 'MUN')
JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu p
  ON l.province_code = p.psgc_code AND l.source_period = p.source_period
 AND p.geographic_level = 'PROV'
WHERE NOT f.has_dq_issues
GROUP BY p.psgc_code, initcap(p.area_name)
config.comment: City/municipality funding grouped by province; utilization bands are not preparedness tiers

dimensions.name: province_name
dimensions.comment: Province name, title-case (Mapbox admin1 name match)

dimensions.name: risk_tier
dimensions.comment: Reported utilization band, not a preparedness or disaster-risk tier

WITH indicator_rows AS (
WITH fact_fix AS (
  SELECT f.psgc_code AS psgc_code,
         f.year AS year,

  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_cmci_indicator f
),
latest AS (

  FROM fact_fix
  GROUP BY psgc_code
),
lgus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.psgc_code, la.max_year
  FROM latest la
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
    WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
  ) l
    ON la.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
),
grid AS (
  SELECT g.psgc_code, g.max_year, d.indicator_code
  FROM lgus g
  CROSS JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator d
),
scored AS (
  SELECT g.psgc_code, g.max_year, g.indicator_code,
         f.raw_score
  FROM grid g
  LEFT JOIN fact_fix f
    ON f.psgc_code = g.psgc_code
   AND f.year = g.max_year
   AND f.indicator_code = g.indicator_code
)
SELECT s.psgc_code,
       l.area_name,
       l.province_code,
       rr.region_code,
       reg.area_name AS region_name,
       s.max_year AS year,
       d.pillar_name,
       d.indicator_code,
       d.indicator_name,
       s.raw_score,
       TRY_CAST(s.raw_score AS DOUBLE) AS raw_score_num,
       CASE WHEN s.raw_score IS NOT NULL THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS coverage_pct
FROM scored s
JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator d
  ON s.indicator_code = d.indicator_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name, province_code
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
) l
  ON s.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, region_code
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
) rr
  ON s.psgc_code = rr.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level = 'REG'
) reg
  ON rr.region_code = reg.psgc_code
), coverage AS (
  SELECT psgc_code,
         AVG(coverage_pct) FILTER (WHERE pillar_name = 'Resiliency') / 100.0 AS cmci_resiliency,
         AVG(coverage_pct) FILTER (WHERE pillar_name = 'Government Efficiency') / 100.0 AS cmci_gov_efficiency,
         AVG(coverage_pct) FILTER (WHERE pillar_name = 'Infrastructure') / 100.0 AS cmci_infrastructure,
         AVG(coverage_pct) / 100.0 AS cmci_readiness
  FROM indicator_rows GROUP BY psgc_code
), funding AS (
  SELECT psgc_code, source_period, SUM(total_appropriation) AS total_appropriation,
         SUM(total_expenditure) AS total_expenditure,
         AVG(utilization_rate_total) AS utilization_rate_total
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_ldrrmf WHERE NOT has_dq_issues
  GROUP BY psgc_code, source_period
)
SELECT l.area_name AS lgu_name, p.area_name AS province, r.area_name AS region,
       l.geographic_level AS lgu_type, f.total_appropriation, f.total_expenditure,
       f.utilization_rate_total, pop.population AS city_population,
       c.cmci_resiliency, c.cmci_gov_efficiency, c.cmci_infrastructure, c.cmci_readiness,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_res_score,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_gov_score,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_infra_score,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_overall_score,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_total_score,
       'Unavailable - scoring method pending' AS cmci_readiness_tier,
       CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS quake_count,
       CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS max_magnitude,
       l.psgc_code, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS geometry_wkt
FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu l
LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu p
  ON l.province_code = p.psgc_code AND l.source_period = p.source_period
 AND p.geographic_level = 'PROV'
LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu r
  ON l.region_code = r.psgc_code AND l.source_period = r.source_period
 AND r.geographic_level = 'REG'
LEFT JOIN funding f ON l.psgc_code = f.psgc_code AND l.source_period = f.source_period
LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.fact_population pop
  ON l.psgc_code = pop.psgc_code AND l.source_period = pop.source_period
LEFT JOIN coverage c ON l.psgc_code = c.psgc_code
WHERE l.geographic_level IN ('CITY', 'MUN')

config.source:
WITH fact_fix AS (
  SELECT f.psgc_code AS psgc_code,
         f.year AS year,
         f.indicator_code,
         f.raw_score AS raw_score
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_cmci_indicator f
),
latest AS (
  SELECT psgc_code, MAX(year) AS max_year
  FROM fact_fix
  GROUP BY psgc_code
),
wide AS (
  SELECT f.psgc_code,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'job' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_job,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'leg' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_leg,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'les' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_les,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'sle' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_sle,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'bpls' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_bpls,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'bre' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_bre,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'chs' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_chs,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'cnd' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_cnd,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'css' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_css,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'lgua' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_lgua,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'pao' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_pao,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'pipu' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_pipu,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'rat' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_rat,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'sp' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_sp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'abu' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_abu,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'acc' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_acc,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'atm' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_atm,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'dtp' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_dtp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'edu' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_edu,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'hea' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_hea,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'ict' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_ict,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'inv' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_inv,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'road' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_road,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'trans' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_trans,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'intc' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_intc,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'add' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_add,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'drrmp' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_drrmp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'drrp' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_drrp,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'ei' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_ei,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'ep' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_ep,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'ews' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_ews,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'lra' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_lra,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'lup' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_lup,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'ss' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_ss,
         MAX(CASE WHEN f.indicator_code = 'util' THEN f.raw_score END) AS score_util
  FROM fact_fix f
  JOIN latest la
    ON f.psgc_code = la.psgc_code
   AND f.year = la.max_year
  GROUP BY f.psgc_code
)
SELECT w.psgc_code,
       la.max_year AS year,
       l.area_name,
       p.area_name AS province_name,
       r.area_name AS region_name,
       w.score_job, w.score_leg, w.score_les, w.score_sle,
       w.score_bpls, w.score_bre, w.score_chs, w.score_cnd, w.score_css,
       w.score_lgua, w.score_pao, w.score_pipu, w.score_rat, w.score_sp,
       w.score_abu, w.score_acc, w.score_atm, w.score_dtp, w.score_edu,
       w.score_hea, w.score_ict, w.score_inv, w.score_road, w.score_trans,
       w.score_intc, w.score_add, w.score_drrmp, w.score_drrp, w.score_ei,
       w.score_ep, w.score_ews, w.score_lra, w.score_lup, w.score_ss, w.score_util
FROM wide w
JOIN latest la ON w.psgc_code = la.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name, province_code, region_code
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
) l ON w.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level = 'PROV'
) p ON l.province_code = p.psgc_code
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT psgc_code, area_name
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
  WHERE geographic_level = 'REG'
) r ON l.region_code = r.psgc_code

config.source:
WITH fact_fix AS (
  SELECT
    f.psgc_code AS psgc_code,
    f.year AS year,
    f.indicator_code,
    f.raw_score
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_cmci_indicator AS f
), latest AS (
  SELECT
    psgc_code,
    MAX(year) AS max_year
  FROM fact_fix
  GROUP BY
    psgc_code
), lgus AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    l.psgc_code,
    la.max_year
  FROM latest AS la
  JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      psgc_code
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
    WHERE
      geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
  ) AS l
    ON la.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
), grid AS (
  SELECT
    g.psgc_code,
    g.max_year,
    d.indicator_code
  FROM lgus AS g
  CROSS JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator AS d
), scored AS (
  SELECT
    g.psgc_code,
    g.max_year,
    g.indicator_code,
    f.raw_score
  FROM grid AS g
  LEFT JOIN fact_fix AS f
    ON f.psgc_code = g.psgc_code
    AND f.year = g.max_year
    AND f.indicator_code = g.indicator_code
), indicator_rows AS (
  SELECT
    s.psgc_code,
    l.area_name,
    l.province_code,
    rr.region_code,
    reg.area_name AS region_name,
    s.max_year AS year,
    d.pillar_name,
    d.indicator_code,
    d.indicator_name,
    s.raw_score,
    TRY_CAST(s.raw_score AS DOUBLE) AS raw_score_num,
    CASE WHEN NOT s.raw_score IS NULL THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS coverage_pct
  FROM scored AS s
  JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_cmci_indicator AS d
    ON s.indicator_code = d.indicator_code
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      psgc_code,
      area_name,
      province_code
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
    WHERE
      geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
  ) AS l
    ON s.psgc_code = l.psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      psgc_code,
      region_code
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
    WHERE
      geographic_level IN ('MUN', 'CITY')
  ) AS rr
    ON s.psgc_code = rr.psgc_code
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      psgc_code,
      area_name
    FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu
    WHERE
      geographic_level = 'REG'
  ) AS reg
    ON rr.region_code = reg.psgc_code
), coverage AS (
  SELECT
    psgc_code,
    AVG(coverage_pct) FILTER(WHERE
      pillar_name = 'Resiliency') / 100.0 AS cmci_resiliency,
    AVG(coverage_pct) FILTER(WHERE
      pillar_name = 'Government Efficiency') / 100.0 AS cmci_gov_efficiency,
    AVG(coverage_pct) FILTER(WHERE
      pillar_name = 'Infrastructure') / 100.0 AS cmci_infrastructure,
    AVG(coverage_pct) / 100.0 AS cmci_readiness
  FROM indicator_rows
  GROUP BY
    psgc_code
), funding AS (
  SELECT
    psgc_code,
    source_period,
    SUM(total_appropriation) AS total_appropriation,
    SUM(total_expenditure) AS total_expenditure,
    AVG(utilization_rate_total) AS utilization_rate_total
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.fact_ldrrmf
  WHERE
    NOT has_dq_issues
  GROUP BY
    psgc_code,
    source_period
), base AS (
  SELECT
    l.area_name AS lgu_name,
    p.area_name AS province,
    r.area_name AS region,
    l.geographic_level AS lgu_type,
    f.total_appropriation,
    f.total_expenditure,
    f.utilization_rate_total,
    pop.population AS city_population,
    c.cmci_resiliency,
    c.cmci_gov_efficiency,
    c.cmci_infrastructure,
    c.cmci_readiness,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_res_score,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_gov_score,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_infra_score,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_overall_score,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cmci_total_score,
    'Unavailable - scoring method pending' AS cmci_readiness_tier,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS quake_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS max_magnitude,
    l.psgc_code,
    CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS geometry_wkt
  FROM ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu AS l
  LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu AS p
    ON l.province_code = p.psgc_code
    AND l.source_period = p.source_period
    AND p.geographic_level = 'PROV'
  LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.dim_lgu AS r
    ON l.region_code = r.psgc_code
    AND l.source_period = r.source_period
    AND r.geographic_level = 'REG'
  LEFT JOIN funding AS f
    ON l.psgc_code = f.psgc_code AND l.source_period = f.source_period
  LEFT JOIN ahon_dev.gold.fact_population AS pop
    ON l.psgc_code = pop.psgc_code AND l.source_period = pop.source_period
  LEFT JOIN coverage AS c
    ON l.psgc_code = c.psgc_code
  WHERE
    l.geographic_level IN ('CITY', 'MUN')
)
SELECT
  CONCAT(province, ' - ', lgu_name) AS province_city,
  lgu_name,
  province,
  lgu_type,
  metric_group,
  metric_label,
  metric_value
FROM (
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'CMCI Scores' AS metric_group,
    'CMCI Total Score (max 70)' AS metric_label,
    cmci_total_score AS metric_value
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'CMCI Scores',
    'Resiliency Score',
    cmci_res_score
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'CMCI Scores',
    'Gov Efficiency Score',
    cmci_gov_score
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'CMCI Scores',
    'Infrastructure Score',
    cmci_infra_score
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'Readiness',
    'Fund Utilization Rate',
    utilization_rate_total
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'Exposure & Population',
    'Population',
    city_population
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'Exposure & Population',
    'Earthquakes (M4.5+, 200km)',
    quake_count
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'LDRRMF Investment',
    'Appropriation',
    total_appropriation
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'LDRRMF Investment',
    'Expenditure',
    total_expenditure
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    province,
    lgu_name,
    lgu_type,
    'LDRRMF Investment',
    'Unspent Funds',
    total_appropriation - total_expenditure
  FROM base
)

### [→ Hazard Risk & Exposure Profile](/sql/dashboardsv3/01f1c8b6dae61b53848587474bfa4686/pages/170a5295) LGU monitoring coverage, population exposure, earthquake hazard points, and DRRM fund utilization maps.
### [→ Vulnerability Matrix](/sql/dashboardsv3/01f1c8b6dae61b53848587474bfa4686/pages/vulnerability_matrix) Population exposure vs DRRM fund readiness — high-population LGUs with low utilization.

### [→ DRRM Priority Actions & Preparedness Shortfall](/sql/dashboardsv3/01f1c8b6dae61b53848587474bfa4686/pages/priority_actions) Weakest CMCI pillars by LGU and region, plus appropriations vs expenditures and shortfall tiers per LGU.

# 📖 AHON: My LGU Command Center **What this is:** A DRRM (Disaster Risk Reduction & Management) command center for Philippine cities and municipalities, combining **LDRRM fund utilization**, **CMCI competitiveness scores**, **population exposure**, and **PHIVOLCS seismic activity**. | **Page** | **What it shows** | | :--- | :--- | | **Hazard Risk & Exposure Profile** | Monitoring coverage, population by region, earthquake epicenters, funding table, and choropleth maps of fund utilization | | **Vulnerability Matrix** | Population exposure vs DRRM fund readiness to determine the high population LGUs with low utilization | | **DRRM Priority Actions** | Weakest CMCI pillars per LGU/region and readiness shortfall tiers | ## How to use the filters - **Region / Province filters** (top sidebar, apply to every page) — narrow all visuals to a region or province. - **Fiscal Year filter** — the YoY figures on *Vulnerability Matrix* compare the selected year against the year before. - **LGU Name Search** — type to find a specific city/municipality across all pages. - Clicking a region on a map or bar chart cross-filters the other visuals on that page. Click again (or use *Clear*) to reset. ## Metric definitions - **Utilization rate** = total expenditure ÷ total appropriation of the LDRRM fund, per LGU and fiscal year. - **Readiness tiers** (4-tier ranking): - *Tier 1 — Critical:* utilization below 25% - *Tier 2 — High:* 25–50% - *Tier 3 — Moderate:* 50–75% - *Tier 4 — On Track:* 75% and above - **CMCI readiness** = data coverage and average raw score across the CMCI pillars (Economic Dynamism, Government Efficiency, Infrastructure) plus Resiliency indicators, latest recorded year per LGU. - **Unspent funds** = appropriation − expenditure. ## Data sources | **Source** | **Purpose** | | :--- | :--- | | `BLGF-LDRRMF` | LDRRM fund appropriations/expenditures, LGU registry & PSGC keys | | `CMCI` | CMCI indicator scores (35 indicators, 4 pillars) | | `PSA Population Statistics` | Latest census population per location | | `Philvolcs Earthquake Monitoring Activities` | Earthquake epicenters (M ≥ 4.5) | | `PH Administrative Boundaries` | City/municipality boundary polygons for choropleth maps | ## Refresh The dashboard is published and refreshes on a daily schedule.
